Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Hazem Hafez Ahmed Wafa, reviewed by eng. Mahmoud Abd 
El Hamid El Kholi, reviewed by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd El-Qader 
El-Nagar, accepted by Samir Abd El-Gilil, EDEPC MPIS coordinator approved by 
eng. Awad Fathy head sector of Talkha PS and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman admin and financial inspection quality controls general director, 
and supervisor of EDEPCO inspection and quality controls head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by any one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses 
 ... etc.
Generator isolation 
 and proper earthing is required.
Ensure that the circuit breaker disconnected 
 and secondary disconnect.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes
Complete tool set, brushes
Megger, digital voltmeter
Work to be Carried out
Item | Inspection steps | Test results
1 | Replace the defective 
 components. | 
2 | Replace the worn parts in 
 accordance with relevant instructions. | 
3 | Check the operation of 
 controls. | 
4 | Measure the 
 characteristic values of insulating and arc-quenching media. Tightening of 
 screw connections. | 
5 | Lubricate and replace of 
 grease and oil. | 
6 | Cleaning. | 
7 | Making adjustments to 
 ensure reliable operation. |
